title: Page shows the three fields and the Change button
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it.
step: Open account settings and go to the change password page.
expected: The page should show three fields labelled ‹expected: Current Password [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]›, ‹expected: New Password [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]› and ‹expected: Repeat New Password [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]›.

step: Look at the buttons on the page.
expected: The page should show a button labelled ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]›.

title: Successful change shows a confirmation
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Enter `Old-pass-1` as current password, `New-pass-2` as new password and `New-pass-2` as the repeat.
expected: No error should be shown under any field.

step: Select the ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]› button.
expected: A confirmation message should be shown (text not given in the ticket, see Q6).

title: User stays signed in after a change
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Change the password from `Old-pass-1` to `New-pass-2` with a matching repeat.
expected: A confirmation message should be shown.

step: Open another page of the app, then reload it.
expected: The user should still be signed in. No login page should be shown.

title: New password works at the next login and the old one is refused
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Change the password to `New-pass-2`, then sign out.
step: Sign in with the email and `Old-pass-1`.
expected: The sign-in should be refused with an error message.

step: Sign in with the email and `New-pass-2`.
expected: The sign-in should succeed.

title: Empty Current Password shows an error
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Select the Current Password field, then leave it without typing.
expected: An error should be shown under the Current Password field: ‹expected: Please provide a password. [src: similar:login-and-registration#M5]›.

step: Fill New Password and Repeat New Password with `New-pass-2`, then select ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]› if it is enabled.
expected: The password should not be changed, and the error under Current Password should remain.

title: Empty New Password shows an error
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Select the New Password field, then leave it without typing.
expected: An error should be shown under the New Password field: ‹expected: Please provide a password. [src: similar:login-and-registration#M5]›.

title: Empty Repeat New Password shows an error
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Select the Repeat New Password field, then leave it without typing.
expected: An error should be shown under the Repeat New Password field: ‹expected: Please repeat your password. [src: similar:login-and-registration#M6]›.

title: New Password of 4 characters is refused
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Enter `Old-pass-1` as current password and `Ab1!` as new password and repeat.
expected: An error should be shown under the New Password field: ‹expected: Password must be 5-40 characters long. [src: similar:login-and-registration#M10]›.

step: Select ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]› if it is enabled.
expected: The password should not be changed. Signing in later with `Old-pass-1` should still work.

title: New Password of 5 characters is accepted
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Enter `Old-pass-1` as current password and `Ab1!x` as new password and repeat.
expected: No length error should be shown under the New Password field.

step: Select ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]›.
expected: A confirmation message should be shown.

title: New Password of 40 characters is accepted
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Enter `Old-pass-1` as current password and `Ab1!` followed by 36 times `x` (40 characters in all) as new password and repeat.
expected: No length error should be shown under the New Password field.

step: Select ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]›.
expected: A confirmation message should be shown.

title: Different New and Repeat passwords are refused
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Enter `Old-pass-1` as current password, `New-pass-2` as new password and `New-pass-3` as the repeat, then leave the repeat field.
expected: The user should be told the passwords do not match: ‹expected: Passwords do not match [src: similar:login-and-registration#M11]›.

step: Select ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]› if it is enabled.
expected: The password should not be changed. Signing in later with `Old-pass-1` should still work.

title: Wrong Current Password is refused
preconditions: Register `reconqa-<random>@example.test` with password `Old-pass-1`, then sign in with it. Open the change password page.
step: Enter `Wrong-pass-9` as current password and `New-pass-2` as new password and repeat.
expected: The form should accept the input without a length or mismatch error.

step: Select ‹expected: Change [src: ticket:tickets/change-password.md#L8]›.
expected: A message should be shown that the current password is wrong (text not given in the ticket, see Q5). The password should not be changed.

step: Sign out and sign in with `Old-pass-1`.
expected: The sign-in should succeed.
